race.title: Albert Bartlett Triple Crown Series Handicap Hurdle (Qualifier)
race.verdict: LEJO DU SEUIL shaped well in a stronger race than this last time and makes plenty of appeal with the addition of Bowen in the saddle. Handicap newcomers Majeur Allen and Crystal Orchard complete the shortlist. LEJO DU SEUIL (FR) MAJEUR ALLEN (FR) CRYSTAL ORCHARD (IRE)
